title: SvgPattern
responsibility: Renders the native pattern element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPattern.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet rendered as child content inside the native pattern element when supplied. If omitted or undefined, no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgPattern
outputs.description: The component renders one native pattern element, forwards the remaining props to it as attributes, and renders the optional snippet inside it. It adds no wrapper element.
